newsitem.title: USA: Martek gets patent for blending process.
newsitem.headline: Martek gets patent for blending process.

text.p: Martek Biosciences Corp said on Wednesday that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office granted the patent for how it blends microbially-derived arachidonic acid oil with low eicosapentaenoic acid fish oils used in infant formula and nutritional supplements.
This patent will make it more difficult for the fish oils to be combined with microbial sources of arachidonic acid oils without violating Martek's patent position, the company said.

Fish oil is a potential competitive source of docosahexaenoic acid to Martek's algae-derived DHA oil. Both elements are two primary components of Martek's proprietary infant formula ingredient, Formulaid, Martek said.
Also, Martek said its Formulaid and its component ingredients have been certified kosher by the Orthodox Union Kashruth Division.
